faqs.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.title: Everything You Need to Know About Our CRM Solution

items.question: Who needs CRM software?
items.answer: Businesses of all sizes, from start-ups to large corporations, can benefit from CRM software to manage leads and sales, automate processes, organise customer data, and enhance customer engagement.

items.question: Is CRM software cloud-based or on-premise?
items.answer: Modern CRM systems are primarily cloud-based, which allows access from any device with an internet connection. However, some providers offer on-premise solutions for businesses with specific data control requirements.

items.question: Is CRM software easy to use?
items.answer: Most CRM platforms are designed with user-friendly interfaces. Some even offer training, tutorials, and customer support to help users get started quickly.
